name: Room for You
typography: Georgia editorial serif with Arial practical copy; generous large type and warm contrast.
rationale: Hospitality-inspired space makes the homepage feel like an invitation. The arch and chair are original conceptual artwork, not an implied photograph of the actual office.
mobile: Single column with copy before artwork; room illustration becomes a compact arch; two-column contact details remain readable.
supporting: About section with real-portrait specification and credential slot; approach overview; expandable service, fee, access, and first-contact details.
trust: Real therapist photography and transparent logistics should replace marked placeholders. Low-pressure language and a clear contact destination support informed choice.
seo: Text-based headings and visible Vancouver context; add verified service pages and truthful address once confirmed. The decorative room requires no heavyweight photography.
tradeoff: Warmth can read as a premium lifestyle brand. Keep real professional details prominent and avoid implying the illustrated room exists.
accessibility: Warm neutral surfaces require strong text contrast. The room illustration has a descriptive accessible name that makes its conceptual nature explicit. Maintain generous mobile contact spacing.
